events.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Hydrogen broadly available through its API
events.title_zh: Google 通过 API 广泛开放 Gemini 4 Hydrogen
events.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen across AI Studio and the Gemini API as gemini-4-hydrogen, with a free tier, a 1M-token context window and paid pricing of $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. It is also rolling out in Gemini products and Antigravity. Benchmark gains are Google-reported, not independent results.
events.summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen across AI Studio and the Gemini API as gemini-4-hydrogen, with a free tier, a 1M-token context window and paid pricing of $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. It is also rolling out in Gemini products and Antigravity. Benchmark gains are Google-reported, not independent results.
events.summary_zh: Google 已在 AI Studio 和 Gemini API 开放 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，模型名为 gemini-4-hydrogen，提供免费额度、100 万 token 上下文；付费输入与输出分别为每百万 token 1.5 美元和 7.5 美元。它也在 Gemini 产品和 Antigravity 中逐步开放。性能数据来自 Google 自报，尚非独立结果。
events.why_it_matters: For model-routing and coding-agent teams, this is an immediately callable price-performance option rather than a preview. The practical decision depends on task-level quality, long-context cost and quota behavior under real workloads.
events.why_it_matters_en: For model-routing and coding-agent teams, this is an immediately callable price-performance option rather than a preview. The practical decision depends on task-level quality, long-context cost and quota behavior under real workloads.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对模型路由与编程 agent 团队来说，这是可立即调用的价格—性能选项，而不是预告。是否值得切换，仍取决于真实任务质量、长上下文成本与额度表现。

technical_details.availability: GA in AI Studio and Gemini API; product rollout varies by tier
technical_details.evidence_limit: benchmarks are reported by Google; no independent evaluation in this run

technical_details_zh.开放阶段: AI Studio 与 Gemini API 已可用；产品端按套餐逐步开放
technical_details_zh.证据限制: benchmark 来自 Google 自报；本轮没有独立评测

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用同一组代码修改与长上下文任务，对比当前主力模型的成功率、TTFT、总成本和限流。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, compare task success, TTFT, total cost and rate limits against the current primary model on the same coding and long-context set.

evidence.claim_zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen 已通过公共 API 开放，并公布价格与上下文规格。
evidence.claim_en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is now available through the public API with pricing and context specifications.

changes.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen 已通过公共 API 开放，并公布价格与上下文规格。
changes.summary_en: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is now available through the public API with pricing and context specifications.

events.title: IBM previews LLMON markup and two Granite models for prompt-injection control
events.title_zh: IBM 预览 LLMON 标记语言与两款 Granite 防注入模型
events.summary: IBM released an experimental LLMON toolkit and Granite 4.1 3B/8B preview models trained to separate instructions from data with reserved markup tokens. IBM reports stronger resistance to static prompt injection. The weights and code are public, but adaptive multi-turn attacks remain outside the demonstrated scope.
events.summary_en: IBM released an experimental LLMON toolkit and Granite 4.1 3B/8B preview models trained to separate instructions from data with reserved markup tokens. IBM reports stronger resistance to static prompt injection. The weights and code are public, but adaptive multi-turn attacks remain outside the demonstrated scope.
events.summary_zh: IBM 发布实验性的 LLMON 工具包，以及 Granite 4.1 3B/8B preview 模型，用保留标记把指令与数据分开。IBM 自报它能增强对静态 prompt injection 的抵抗力。权重和代码已公开，但演示范围尚未覆盖自适应多轮攻击。
events.why_it_matters: For agent builders, typed boundaries between instructions and untrusted data could become an enforceable interface rather than prompt wording alone. The current evidence is publisher-run and preview-grade, so it is a test target, not a production security guarantee.
events.why_it_matters_en: For agent builders, typed boundaries between instructions and untrusted data could become an enforceable interface rather than prompt wording alone. The current evidence is publisher-run and preview-grade, so it is a test target, not a production security guarantee.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 agent 开发者来说，把指令与不可信数据做成有类型的边界，可能比单靠提示词措辞更可控。当前证据由发布方提供，模型仍是 preview，因此只能作为测试对象，不能当作生产安全保证。

technical_details.method: reserved markup tokens distinguish instructions, data and control regions
technical_details.availability: public preview weights and open toolkit
technical_details.limitation: adaptive and multi-turn attacks not established

technical_details_zh.方法: 用保留标记区分指令、数据与控制区域
technical_details_zh.开放范围: 公开 preview 权重与开源工具包
technical_details_zh.证据: 发布方运行的静态 prompt injection 测试
technical_details_zh.局限: 尚未验证自适应与多轮攻击

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开权重和工具包重放 50 条静态与多轮注入样本，记录误放、误拒和格式破坏率。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, replay 50 static and multi-turn injection cases with the public weights and toolkit, recording bypass, false refusal and markup-corruption rates.

evidence.claim_zh: IBM 公开 LLMON 工具包与两款 Granite preview 权重。
evidence.claim_en: IBM publishes the LLMON toolkit and two Granite preview checkpoints.

changes.summary_zh: IBM 公开 LLMON 工具包与两款 Granite preview 权重。
changes.summary_en: IBM publishes the LLMON toolkit and two Granite preview checkpoints.

events.title: CapLite moves agent authorization from model judgment into code
events.title_zh: CapLite 把 agent 授权从模型判断移到代码执行
events.summary: CapLite proposes a capability system in which the model proposes actions while deterministic code authorizes them. Across 15 open-weight models, the authors report zero successful attacks in 13,935 attacked episodes, while model-authored policy and graph baselines failed on many models. No public implementation was verified in this run.
events.summary_en: CapLite proposes a capability system in which the model proposes actions while deterministic code authorizes them. Across 15 open-weight models, the authors report zero successful attacks in 13,935 attacked episodes, while model-authored policy and graph baselines failed on many models. No public implementation was verified in this run.
events.summary_zh: CapLite 提出一种 capability system：模型只提出动作，确定性代码负责授权。作者在 15 个开放权重模型上测试，自报 13,935 个受攻击 episode 中没有成功攻击，而由模型编写策略或图的基线在多个模型上失效。本轮未核实到公开实现。
events.why_it_matters: For tool-using agents, this supports a concrete design rule: keep authority in code and let the model request narrowly scoped capabilities. The result is promising but remains a paper claim without a public artifact or independent reproduction.
events.why_it_matters_en: For tool-using agents, this supports a concrete design rule: keep authority in code and let the model request narrowly scoped capabilities. The result is promising but remains a paper claim without a public artifact or independent reproduction.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对工具型 agent 来说，这支持一条具体设计原则：权限留在代码里，模型只能申请窄范围 capability。结果很强，但目前仍是论文结论，没有公开实现或独立复现。

technical_details.architecture: model proposes; deterministic code authorizes capabilities
technical_details.availability: paper only; no public code verified

technical_details_zh.架构: 模型提出动作；确定性代码授权 capability
technical_details_zh.开放范围: 仅论文；本轮未核实到公开代码
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 作者实验，尚无独立复现

events.next_action_zh: 等待公开实现或独立复现覆盖自适应多轮攻击后，再评估是否改造现有工具授权层。
events.next_action_en: Re-evaluate changes to the tool authorization layer after public code or independent reproduction covers adaptive multi-turn attacks.

evidence.claim_zh: CapLite 论文报告用代码授权 capability 可抵挡其测试中的注入攻击。
evidence.claim_en: The CapLite paper reports that code-authorized capabilities resist the tested injection attacks.

changes.summary_zh: CapLite 论文报告用代码授权 capability 可抵挡其测试中的注入攻击。
changes.summary_en: The CapLite paper reports that code-authorized capabilities resist the tested injection attacks.

events.title: Edge0 releases 145B model weights and a laptop-oriented local runtime
events.title_zh: Edge0 公开 145B 模型权重与笔记本本地运行时
events.summary: Edge0 published NVFP4 weights for Edge0-145B and Edge0-120B plus its v0.2.0 local inference runtime. The publisher reports 29GB peak memory and more than 80 tokens per second for Edge0-145B on a compatible laptop. Those performance and benchmark figures are internal and were not independently reproduced in this run.
events.summary_en: Edge0 published NVFP4 weights for Edge0-145B and Edge0-120B plus its v0.2.0 local inference runtime. The publisher reports 29GB peak memory and more than 80 tokens per second for Edge0-145B on a compatible laptop. Those performance and benchmark figures are internal and were not independently reproduced in this run.
events.summary_zh: Edge0 公开 Edge0-145B 与 Edge0-120B 的 NVFP4 权重，以及 v0.2.0 本地推理运行时。发布方自报 Edge0-145B 可在兼容笔记本上以 29GB 峰值内存运行，解码速度超过 80 token/s。这些性能与 benchmark 数据均为内部结果，本轮没有独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: For local-model teams, public 145B-class weights and a cross-platform runtime create a directly testable alternative to cloud APIs. The unusually low memory and high throughput claims require hardware-specific reproduction before architecture decisions.
events.why_it_matters_en: For local-model teams, public 145B-class weights and a cross-platform runtime create a directly testable alternative to cloud APIs. The unusually low memory and high throughput claims require hardware-specific reproduction before architecture decisions.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对本地模型团队来说，公开的 145B 级权重和跨平台运行时提供了可直接测试的云 API 替代方案。低内存与高吞吐数据异常突出，做架构决策前必须在目标硬件复现。

technical_details.runtime: Edge0 v0.2.0 for macOS, Windows and Linux
technical_details.evidence_limit: publisher-run measurements and benchmarks; no independent reproduction

technical_details_zh.运行时: Edge0 v0.2.0，支持 macOS、Windows 与 Linux
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 发布方测量与 benchmark；没有独立复现

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开权重和运行时在目标笔记本复跑固定代码集，记录峰值内存、TTFT、吞吐、功耗与任务成功率。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, run the public weights and runtime on the target laptop with a fixed coding set, recording peak memory, TTFT, throughput, power and task success.

evidence.claim_zh: Edge0 公开 145B/120B NVFP4 权重与本地运行时。
evidence.claim_en: Edge0 publishes 145B/120B NVFP4 weights and a local runtime.

changes.summary_zh: Edge0 公开 145B/120B NVFP4 权重与本地运行时。
changes.summary_en: Edge0 publishes 145B/120B NVFP4 weights and a local runtime.

events.title: Brave Search API adds per-request USDC payments through x402
events.title_zh: Brave Search API 通过 x402 支持逐请求 USDC 支付
events.summary: Brave added x402 endpoints that let software or agents pay for each Search API request in USDC on Base without an account or API key. An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with a quoted price and payment details; the client signs the payment and retries. The official page provides date-only publication precision.
events.summary_en: Brave added x402 endpoints that let software or agents pay for each Search API request in USDC on Base without an account or API key. An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with a quoted price and payment details; the client signs the payment and retries. The official page provides date-only publication precision.
events.summary_zh: Brave 为 Search API 增加 x402 端点，让软件或 agent 无需账号和 API key，就能在 Base 上用 USDC 逐请求付款。未付款请求先返回带价格与支付信息的 HTTP 402，客户端签名后重试。官方页面只有发布日期，没有时分精度。
events.why_it_matters: For agent infrastructure, usage can now be authorized and settled per search rather than through a prepaid account credential. The operational tradeoff shifts toward wallet security, stablecoin exposure, per-request accounting and blockchain availability.
events.why_it_matters_en: For agent infrastructure, usage can now be authorized and settled per search rather than through a prepaid account credential. The operational tradeoff shifts toward wallet security, stablecoin exposure, per-request accounting and blockchain availability.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 agent 基础设施来说，搜索用量可以逐次授权和结算，不再依赖预付账号凭据。新的取舍转向钱包安全、稳定币风险、逐请求记账和区块链可用性。

technical_details.payment: USDC on Base; other networks and stablecoins planned
technical_details.authentication: no Brave account or API key for x402 endpoints
technical_details.flow: quote in 402 response, sign payment, retry request
technical_details.time_basis: official page provides date 2026-11-12 only; HN discovery occurred after the prior checkpoint

technical_details_zh.支付: Base 上的 USDC；其他网络与稳定币仍是计划
technical_details_zh.认证: x402 端点无需 Brave 账号或 API key
technical_details_zh.流程: 402 返回报价，签名付款后重试请求
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方页面仅有 2026-11-12 日期；HN 发现时间晚于上次 checkpoint

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用隔离钱包发起 20 次测试查询，核对报价、失败重试、余额上限、账务对账与链故障行为。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, use an isolated wallet for 20 test queries and verify quotes, failed retries, balance caps, reconciliation and chain-outage behavior.

evidence.claim_en: Brave Search API launches per-request USDC payments through x402.
